cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Student must explicitly choose connectionless service

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Reasoning for connectionless choice based on interaction patterns and overhead
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL requires identifying multiple partners/short interactions AND the overhead of connection setup/teardown
evidence_facets: overhead in the connecting and disconnecting phase
acceptable_variants: frequent connections are inefficient for short data transfers
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 1.33 marks per independent argument (partners/short duration, overhead avoidance); reasoning only → 1-3 marks depending on depth
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Reasoning for the choice (many partners / short interactions / overhead) (4 marks)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: because you will communicate with various partners (websites) for short periods of time. If you would initiate a connection with every website you skim, that would incur a lot of overhead in the connecting and disconnecting phase, just to have very short data transfers.
